pages.text: $(o)...the whispers took Ilsa first, then Corran. Our master, $(l)Vael$(), said he would carry what we could not.$(br2)He drew the corruption out of every one of us and into himself.$(br2)He did not die. I wish he had. He grew quiet, and then he grew $(l)vast$(), and the Hollow grew quiet with him.$()
pages.title: The Third Fragment
